title: Vintage Pick Up Notifier
description: 1.7.10 Forge backport of Pick Up Notifier.
body:
# Vintage Pick Up Notifier `1.7.10 Forge` [Pick Up Notifier](https://github.com/Fuzss/pick-up-notifier) backport. ![logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintagePickUpNotifier/master/images/logo_small.png) [![hub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintagePickUpNotifier/master/images/badges/github.png)](https://github.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintageResourcify/releases) ![forge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintagePickUpNotifier/master/images/badges/forge.png) [![cord](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintagePickUpNotifier/master/images/badges/cord.png)](https://discord.gg/xAWCqGrguG) ![screenshot1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintagePickUpNotifier/master/images/screenshots/s1.png) ## Features * Feature parity with the original mod, as of version `v26.1.1` * Fixed XP value vs orb amount toggle * Customizable gap size between notifications ## Dependencies * [UniMixins](https://modrinth.com/mod/unimixins) [![curse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintagePickUpNotifier/master/images/icons/curse.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/unimixins) [![modrinth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintagePickUpNotifier/master/images/icons/modrinth.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/unimixins/versions) [![git](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintagePickUpNotifier/master/images/icons/git.png)](https://github.com/LegacyModdingMC/UniMixins/releases) * [FentLib](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fentlib) [![curse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintagePickUpNotifier/master/images/icons/curse.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fentlib) [![modrinth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintagePickUpNotifier/master/images/icons/modrinth.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fentlib) [![67](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintagePickUpNotifier/master/images/icons/67.png)](https://67.fentanylsolutions.org/mod/fentlib) [![git](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintagePickUpNotifier/master/images/icons/git.png)](https://github.com/JackOfNoneTrades/FentLib) ## Compatibility This mod is compatible with the following mods: * OKBackpack [![curse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintagePickUpNotifier/master/images/icons/curse.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/okbackpack) [![git](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JackOfNoneTrades/VintagePickUpNotifier/master/images/icons/git.png)](https://github.com/Shigure-Ruiseki/OKBackpack) ## Building ```sh ./gradlew build ``` ## Credits * [Pick Up Notifier](https://github.com/Fuzss/pick-up-notifier) by Fuzss * [GT:NH buildscript](https://github.com/GTNewHorizons/ExampleMod1.7.10) ## License `LGPLv3`. * [Pick Up Notifier code is licensed under Mozilla Public License Version 2.0](https://github.com/Fuzss/pick-up-notifier/blob/main/LICENSE.md). ##
